topics.blurb: Fighters who stood for an army, a city or a cause.

topics.name: Founders & Kings
topics.blurb: Heroes a city, a dynasty or a people claimed as their beginning.

topics.name: Tragic Figures
topics.blurb: Heroes undone by the quality that made them heroes.

topics.name: Sages & Teachers
topics.blurb: Those remembered for what they knew and passed on.

topics.name: Culture Bringers
topics.blurb: The ones who brought fire, writing, law or agriculture - and usually paid for it.

topics.name: Voyagers & Questers
topics.blurb: Those sent a long way for a single object - and changed more by the journey than the prize.

topics.name: Demigods & Divine Blood
topics.blurb: Born of a god and a mortal, and at home in neither world.

topics.name: Ancestors & Progenitors
topics.blurb: Heroes a people traced their descent from.

topics.name: Tricksters & Outlaws
topics.blurb: Heroes who win by wit, theft or nerve rather than by arms.

topics.name: Monster Slayers
topics.blurb: The oldest job description in myth: something is eating the countryside, and one person goes out to it.
